content:
Nina Kapoor: Heads up — Skylark (midmarket) flagged 'at-risk' in CRM. Renewal in 34 days, DAUs dropped 42% vs baseline. They mentioned complexity in onboarding their 3rd-party ETL.
Theo Grant: bummer. Do we know if this is product friction or infra flakiness?
Riley Park: telemetry shows 15% of ingestion jobs hit our backoff loop; most are transient auth errors. I filed infra ticket earlier today.
Nina Kapoor: ok, want to try a Save Ladder pilot: two-tier rapid intervention + feedback capture. Goal: stop downgrade convo this billing cycle.
Theo Grant: outline?
Riley Park: proposal: Step 0 - pre-call diag (5–10m) run by customer; Step 1 - 60m ops deep-dive + live remediation; Step 2 - 14-day pilot discount (25% off) conditional on meeting engagement SLAs; Step 3 - NPS + product feedback sync at end.
SupportBot: Open tickets for Skylark: #10234 (ingest-auth), #10277 (batch timeouts). Latest update: 2026-04-03 09:12 UTC.
Nina Kapoor: I'll own the customer invite and pilot agreement. Theo — can you prepare a minimal downgrade 'Essentials' doc for low-cost continuity if they still decide to shrink footprint? Keep it reversible.
Theo Grant: yea — I'll draft Essentials + Trim plans. Essentials: disable non-core analytics exports, cap concurrent worker pools at 2, maintain embeddings; Trim: reduce retention window to 3 days, disable live rerank. Both include immediate rollback and data snapshot.
Riley Park: pre-call diag I'll paste here — tiny checklist the customer runs before the enablement call: ```bash
# health check
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" https://api.redwood.prod/health | jq .
# quick ingest sample
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.prod/streams/test -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"payload":"sample"}'
# fetch last 50 lines of agent log
aws logs tail /aws/logs/skylark-ingest --since 2h --max-items 50
```
Nina Kapoor: perfect. Riley — can you also add a short note asking them to paste 2 failing payloads in the thread? That speeds root cause.
Riley Park: done. Pinned note in account thread.
Theo Grant: terms: discount applies if we run the enablement within 7 days and usage improves by at least 8% over the 14-day pilot. If not, discount void but we keep the post-mortem and product ticket priority. Add that to the pilot doc.
SupportBot: Reminder created: Skylark enablement session proposed: 2026-04-08 17:00 UTC.
Nina Kapoor: I'll propose Fri 10am PT. Also requesting SSO screen-share for their ops lead; note that co-browse needs advanced access — CS Ops please approve.
CS Ops: Approved. Please include the co-browse flag in the invite.
Riley Park: FYI I found a related regression in token refresh flow that might be the root cause. I'll escalate to eng-runtime before the session.
Theo Grant: good call. For the downgrade doc, I'll make sure the language focuses on 'no data deletion' and 'rollback in <30m' for trust.
Nina Kapoor: Feedback loop plan: 1) collect quick 3-question survey at pilot end (ease of use, time-to-value, likelihood to renew), 2) capture 3 anonymized logs and one quote to send to product, 3) schedule 30-min product sync if NPS <= 6.
Riley Park: adding a short template for survey: "How easy was remediation? (1-10), Did the pilot meet your immediate needs? (yes/no), How likely are you to renew? (1-10)"
Theo Grant: also add billing note: apply credit as one-time invoice adjustment; must be requested within 10 days of pilot end.
Nina Kapoor: next steps: I send invite, Riley escalates token-refresh bug, Theo drafts downgrade doc, SupportBot will track tickets. We'll reconvene in this thread after the call with a 1-paragraph post-call note.
SupportBot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2026-04-22 17:00 UTC to capture pilot NPS and renewal update.
Nina Kapoor: quick update — call happened, ran remediation, ingests recovered for 90% of jobs, customer accepted the 14-day pilot. They left a quick note: "Helped us unblock critical batch jobs; thanks for the quick turnaround." Moving CRM state: at-risk -> pilot. I'll upload post-call notes to drive and flag for product sync if NPS < 7.
Theo Grant: thanks — uploading downgrade doc now: https://redwood.app/drive/skylark-essentials-trim (shared).
Riley Park: logged the regression to eng-runtime and linked ticket #10311.
Nina Kapoor: closing loop here — pilot running. Will post final renewal outcome in this thread once we have it. :tada:
